title: No assembly instructions
text:
No assembly instructions. This only got an OKAY rating becaue it is still in pieces on my living room floor. There were no assembly instructions included. The packages for various hardware came open in transit and washers and bolts and whatever else was rolling around inside one of the pieces of this couch. I am still finding washers concealed in the couch pieces. Provide me with assembly instructions and a part list and I'm a happy camper. Fail me and I am very unhappy indeed.

Update. Illustration shows 3 back cushions.

product_metadata.title: NHI Express Alexandra Convertible Sectional, Mocha
description: The Alexandra Convertible Sectional has a sleek modern look that will look great with any style in your home. The Alexandra Convertible Sectional can be switch around as a left facing or right facing sectional. Best part is you can even make it as a sofa with ottoman if you want to change things up. NOTE: All the parts are tucked underneath the frames of sofa, just open the velcro at the bottom of the sofa frame, chaise frame and ottoman frame.

details.Special Feature: Chaise doubles as ottoman, Reversible chaise
